'''Alexey Feridovich Izmailov''' ({{langx|ru|Алексе́й Фери́дович Измаи́лов}}) (born 1967) is a [[Russian mathematician]] who is a [[Professor (highest academic rank)|professor]] at the [[MSU CMC|Faculty of Computer Science at the Moscow State University]].<ref>[http://letopis.msu.ru/peoples/3939 Annals of the Moscow University]{{in lang|ru}}</ref><ref>[http://io.cs.msu.su/preps/izmailov.htm MSU CMC]{{in lang|ru}}</ref>

He defended the thesis ''Stable methods of finding special solutions of non-linear problems'' for the degree of [[Doctor of Science|Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences]] in 1998.{{citation needed|date=June 2018}}

He has authored 12 books and more than 150 scientific articles.<ref>[https://istina.msu.ru/profile/izmaf/ Scientific works of Alexey Izmailov]</ref><ref>[http://www.mathnet.ru/php/person.phtml?personid=17743&option_lang=eng Scientific works of Alexey Izmailov]{{in lang|en}}</ref>
